description: 50m-wide x 25m-deep rectangle, entrance at the midpoint of the 50m edge. Too shallow for an estate road (road + one row of plots needs ~25-26m on this width), but the 50m frontage itself is long enough to hold several plots directly — the frontage-ribbon topology's core case.
